# Bestiary Lens 1.0.0

First public release of Bestiary Lens for Queen's Domain.

## Features

- Shows a contextual native-style bestiary card when aiming at an enemy, with base HP, attack, XP, resistances, standard loot, icons and drop rates when available.
- Keeps undiscovered or excluded enemy details hidden; reads save progression without writing save data.
- F9 toggles the card. F10 opens the displayed unlocked enemy's native bestiary entry.
- Uses localized captions and assets already present in the game.

## Install and compatibility

Download `BestiaryLens-1.0.0.zip` and follow the included README. Requires Queen's Domain (Windows game build, UE 4.27.2) and a working UE4SS installation with Lua support and `LoopInGameThreadWithDelay`. Windows and Linux/Steam Deck through Proton are documented targets, but compatibility depends on the UE4SS/game environment; native Windows behavior and other UE4SS builds are unverified. Offline tests and Steam Deck (Proton) smoke testing cover loader startup, HUD construction, native captions and F10 opening a native bestiary entry. Broader gameplay and controller coverage is limited.

The ZIP contains the Lua mod scripts, README and MIT license only. Game/UE4SS assets, development tools and SDK data are not included. The mod does not access the network, alter combat/loot/progression, or write save data. See README for limitations and recovery instructions.
